Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly identified the major process of surface rock formation on volcanoes. While it is true that intrusive igneous rocks form from slow cooling deep underground (Option C), the question specifically asks about "surface rock formation on volcanoes." Volcanic rocks (extrusive igneous rocks) are formed when magma erupts onto the surface as lava and cools rapidly (Option A). The Planner failed to distinguish between the context of "surface" versus "deep underground," leading to the wrong conclusion.
